title: Derived restriction and extension of scalars for ordinary modules
statement: For commutative rings $A$ and $B$ and a ring homomorphism $f:A\to B$, with chosen unbounded derived categories $D(A)$ and $D(B)$ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], define derived restriction of scalars $D(B)\to D(A)$ as the derived functor of $\operatorname{ModCat}.restrictScalars(f)$. It has its canonical right-adjoint structure. Define $\operatorname{moduleDerivedExtension}(f):D(A)\to D(B)$ to be the left adjoint of this restriction functor; this is the canonical unbounded derived extension of scalars (Stacks Tags 06YY and 07A6). These are the ordinary-module scalar functors of [lem-sfb-constant-realization-derived-scalar-extension], re-exposed without changing their construction.
